notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have an have a new build that should address some of the issues that people were experiencing.

Issues Addressed:
[olist]
 The Menu Glitch that lead to a soft-lock
 The fog glitch/crash that people were experiencing loading into a dungeon
 The blur has been toned down a bit without impacting performance
[/olist]

We are sorry it took so long for the people experiencing these issues! The issues proved to be very tricky to solve.

notes.title: Glitch Outfits
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We launched an update not too long ago adjusting the Glitch outfits for Lucil and Celica, they should be using their outfits from the first game now.

Additionally, we are working hard on the issues that have been reported and discussed on the forums.

Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Upcoming Improvements
notes.content:
Hello Death end re;Quest™ 2 fans! It's been brought to our attention that Lucil and Celica are missing their original Glitch costumes in the Steam® version of the game.

Additionally, some people have been having crashes upon loading into dungeons, and the menus failing, among other issues.

We're actively working to get these issues fixed and will update users ASAP. Thank you very much for your patience and understanding!
